name: Office AI Assistant for Order & Logistics Tracking

mentions.name: Office AI Assistant for Order & Logistics Tracking
mentions.description: An internal-office AI assistant that connects with project management tools, Google Sheets, and shipment tracking apps. It helps teams manage orders, track production statuses, pull real-time updates, and summarize next steps without switching between different systems, streamlining operations and speeding up project and logistics tracking.
mentions.problem: Teams have to switch between different systems to manage orders, track production, and follow shipments, slowing down operations and logistics tracking.
mentions.audience: Internal office teams managing orders, production, and logistics
mentions.source_excerpt: an AI assistant that connects with project management tools, Google Sheets, and shipment tracking apps. It helps teams manage orders, track production statuses, pull real-time updates, and summarize next steps — all without switching between different systems.
